description: A member of the mesh, as info's mesh lists it.

bonjour.description: Its name on the local network.

dial.description: false: it can't be linked to, only from (a phone, with no sshd).

through.description: The member it's reached through, by name; null for one linked to here.

commit.description: The commit its code is (null: not a checkout, or it didn't say).

made.description: When that commit was made, in seconds (null: not known).

heads.description: The apps connected to it, by the code they run.

behind.description: How many commits it lacks of the mesh's newest code (MeshView's newest), as this host's git counts them (null: it can't).
